verdict.rationale: LlamaParse applies AI to user documents inside the platform. It offers AI-powered extraction, classification and splitting, and prompt-based auto-generated extraction schemas, which are a form of AI suggestion. Its Index/agent examples let users query documents, but those are deprecated cloud-index examples built by the developer, not an in-product insights feature. Its outputs are transformations of documents rather than proactive insights or recommendations about the user's data. Missing for 10: an in-product insights or recommendations surface, proactive AI suggestions beyond schema generation, a non-deprecated built-in Q&A/analysis experience, and independent corroboration.
